maya (DevEx): Heads-up — onboarding flagged that customers are confused by how our SDKs show 401 vs 403 and how retry behavior is surfaced.
raj (SDK): which SDKs? node/go/python?
maya (DevEx): mostly node + go sampleapp logs. Users see `AuthError` vs HTTP 403 but retry logic isn't consistent across languages.
sophia (PM): is it token refresh vs permission scope errors?
kevin (eng): yep. We treat 401 as refreshable, 403 as permission denied. Problem is some SDKs collapse both into `GenericError` and drop http status/code.
maya (DevEx): exact. Example from a customer log for the node sampleapp: 
```json
{"error":{"type":"GenericError","message":"request failed","http_status":403,"code":"forbidden"}}
```
raj (SDK): ouch. We should expose `PermissionDeniedError` with `retryable: false` and a machine hint.
sophia (PM): +1 to adding a `hint` field that suggests next steps like "check token scopes" or "request additional permissions". That will reduce support back-and-forth.
maya (DevEx): proposal: a standard error envelope used by all SDKs and sampleapps, minimal but machine-friendly: 
```json
{"error_type":"string","code":"string","message":"string","http_status":123,"retryable":true,"hint":"string"}
```
kevin (eng): i like it. For 429 also include `retry_after` (seconds) or `quota_reset` ISO timestamp.
raj (SDK): for go we can implement typed errors that satisfy interfaces `Retryable() bool` and `StatusCode() int` so callers can branch without parsing strings.
maya (DevEx): also keep message concise — avoid dumping tracebacks into user-facing `message`. Put full details in logs/telemetry.
sophia (PM): telemetry-wise we want `error_surface_v2` tag so we can compare before/after with cohorts.
deploy-bot: deployment window planned: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC :rocket:
maya (DevEx): roll plan i propose: (1) spec the envelope, (2) add typed errors in node/go/python, (3) update all sampleapps to emit new shape, (4) add SDK shims for backward compat, (5) update onboarding docs and quickstarts.
kevin (eng): note on 5xxs: we should encode nuance. Some 5xx are transient, some are permanent (db corruption). Suggest `retry_policy` field with values: `none`, `idempotent_only`, `safe`, `always`.
raj (SDK): will add `retry_policy` and `retry_after` to the spec. Also plan to implement shims so older clients still see old shapes until migration.
sophia (PM): timeline? We want this in the next onboarding cohort in ~4 weeks.
maya (DevEx): i'll draft the spec doc and link a PR. Quick poll: thumbs if you agree with `retryable` boolean + `hint` string in the envelope.
raj (SDK): :thumbsup:
kevin (eng): :thumbsup:
sophia (PM): :thumbsup:
maya (DevEx): Great. Action items — @raj implement go types + interface, @kevin update sampleapps + add examples, @sophia refresh onboarding docs and sample prompts. I'll own the spec PR and the telemetry tags.
raj (SDK): starting PRs today, will add unit tests for mapping 401/403/429/5xx and the shims.
kevin (eng): i'll update node sampleapp and run a small canary against staging.
sophia (PM): i'll add a short FAQ for customer-facing docs about "When should I retry?"
maya (DevEx): thanks team — this should reduce support noise and make DX parity much better.
